newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Baoding Swan set to list 67.50 mln A shares.
newsitem.headline: China Baoding Swan set to list 67.50 mln A shares.

text.p: Chemical fibre maker Baoding Swan Co Ltd said on Tuesday it will list 67.5 million A shares on the Shenzhen bourse on February 21.
The A share offer was launched in Shenzhen last month at 6.30 yuan per share and was 50.7 times oversubscribed, the firm said in a statement carried in Tuesday's Shenzhen-based Securities Times.

The company, based in Baoding city, Hebei province, now has a total of 295 million shares outstanding, consisting of 220 million state shares, 67.5 million A shares and 7.5 million staff shares, it said.

A company spokesman told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin the company would use the proceeds to increase annual viscose silk production capacity to 18,000 tonnes from the current 10,500.
Swan exports part of its products to more than 10 countries including South Korea and Canada, the spokesman said.
Swan said it forecast net profits of 101.59 million yuan for 1997, compared with 117.18 million yuan estimated for 1996, and 133.61 million yuan posted in 1995.
Net profit for the first nine months of 1996 was 90.72 million yuan, it said.
